headword: {重要文化財|じゅうようぶんかざい}
reading: じゅうようぶんかざい

definitions.explanation: A category of protected cultural assets designated by the Japanese government under the Act on Protection of Cultural Properties. Includes buildings, artworks, crafts, and other historically or artistically significant objects. Often abbreviated as {重文|じゅうぶん}.

examples.japanese: この{寺|てら}は{重要文化財|じゅうようぶんかざい}に{指定|してい}されている。
examples.english: This temple is designated as an Important Cultural Property.

examples.japanese: {博物館|はくぶつかん}には{多|おお}くの{重要文化財|じゅうようぶんかざい}が{展示|てんじ}されている。
examples.english: Many Important Cultural Properties are displayed in the museum.

examples.japanese: {昨年|さくねん}、{新|あら}たに{三|みっ}つの{建造物|けんぞうぶつ}が{重要文化財|じゅうようぶんかざい}に{指定|してい}され、{地元|じもと}では{保存活動|ほぞんかつどう}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Last year, three more structures were designated as Important Cultural Properties, and preservation efforts began locally.

notes:
Abbreviated as {重文|じゅうぶん} in everyday use and media. Part of a tiered system: items of exceptional importance may be further elevated to {国宝|こくほう} (National Treasure).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重要文化財|じゅうようぶんかざい}に{指定|してい}する (designate as an Important Cultural Property)
- {重要文化財|じゅうようぶんかざい}に{登録|とうろく}する (register as an Important Cultural Property)
- {重要文化財|じゅうようぶんかざい}の{修復|しゅうふく} (restoration of an Important Cultural Property)

USAGE NOTES:
Covers tangible cultural properties including {建造物|けんぞうぶつ} (structures), {絵画|かいが} (paintings), {彫刻|ちょうこく} (sculptures), and {工芸品|こうげいひん} (crafts). Intangible cultural heritage uses the separate term {無形文化財|むけいぶんかざい}.
